name: ariestools-skills
description: Agent skills for Aries Tools TypeScript development: shared conventions, the @ariestools/toolchain xy CLI, ESLint and TypeScript configs, Vitest presets, dependency policy, the @ariestools/sdk utility libraries, the @ariestools/sdk-react React UI libraries, actor-kit actors and providers with their cli-kit and browser-kit hosts, and repository documentation conventions for agents (AGENTS.md, docs/papers lifecycle, xy agent lint).
shortDescription: Aries Tools TypeScript toolchain, development, SDK, React SDK, actor-kit, and agent documentation (AGENTS.md) skills.
longDescription: A layered skill stack for Aries Tools repositories: TypeScript/Git/testing standards (xy-development), the @ariestools/* toolchain surface — xy CLI, configs, vitest-config, deplint (xy-toolchain) — and three sibling library skills on top: the @ariestools/sdk utility libraries plus specialist packages (ariestools-sdk), the @ariestools/sdk-react React UI packages with their peers, import rule and house patterns (ariestools-sdk-react), and actor-kit actors, providers and the actor engine with the cli-kit and browser-kit hosts (ariestools-actor). A cross-cutting companion covers repository documentation conventions for agents — the AGENTS.md entry point, per-tool adapters, the docs/ and papers/ lifecycle, and xy agent lint (xy-agent).
defaultPrompts: Use @ariestools/sdk fetchJson with a custom fetcher
Fix xy agent lint findings in this repo's AGENTS.md and docs/
Fix xy deplint findings for a private service
Write a PeriodicActor and run it in a CLI with @ariestools/cli-kit
